title: Current Implementation and Future Options for Stroke Aftercare—An Exploratory, Cross-Sectoral, Questionnaire-Based Study in the Greater Leipzig Area
summary:
A working group at Leipzig University Medical Center, in collaboration with the German Stroke Foundation, is focusing on stroke aftercare. Through an online survey, the group aims to gain a better understanding of stroke aftercare, identify existing barriers, and lay the groundwork for considerations regarding the future design of aftercare, including the use of digital applications. 
We are surveying outpatient physicians and medical assistants in general practice and neurology offices, physicians employed at acute care hospitals, and patients in the greater Leipzig area regarding current and future stroke follow-up care practices.
conditions: Stroke, not specified as haemorrhage or infarction

interventions.name: No intervention or observation group. Anonymous survey study. -> Anonymous Survey on Stroke Aftercare

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Physicians and medical assistants from the invited practices/clinics, For patients: a stroke that occurred at least 6 months ago
Exclusion criteria:
People who do not speak German good enough
